lines.vo: Eyy. As our story opens in da smoky bawra of Leadville, an honest plumbah is about ta make an offah... he don't entirely unnastand.
lines.cc: As our story opens in the smoky borough of Leadville, an honest plumber is about to make an offer... he doesn't entirely understand.

lines.vo: Fawty bucks fa one lead. Ehh. Business is business.
lines.cc: Forty bucks for one lead. Eh. Business is business.

lines.vo: Business, sweethawt, was about ta get very poisonal. Like everyt'ing else in dis beautiful, rotten neighbahhood.
lines.cc: Business, dear viewer, was about to get very personal. Like everything else in this beautiful, rotten neighborhood.

lines.vo: Mafia Mahketing. Episode one. Fuhgeddaboudit.
lines.cc: Mafia Marketing. Episode One.

lines.vo: Salvatore! Come ina, come ina! You want-a leads? Eyy — da Family's gotta leads. Fresha. Hotta. Excloosive.
lines.cc: Salvatore! Come in, come in! You want leads? The Family has leads. Fresh. Hot. Exclusive.

lines.vo: Excloosive? So it's just mine?
lines.cc: Exclusive? So it's just mine?

lines.vo: ...It's-a yours-ish.
lines.cc: ...It's yours-ish.

lines.vo: We solda it ta fawh guys, bo—
lines.cc: We sold it to four guys, bo—

lines.vo: VINNIE.
lines.cc: VINNIE.

lines.vo: An' dere it was. Da woid no contractah survives. Yours-ish.
lines.cc: And there it was. The word no contractor survives. Yours-ish.

lines.vo: Ya see, one leaky faucet became one 'lead'... an' one lead became fawh invoices. Da Family calls dis... efficiency.
lines.cc: You see, one leaky faucet became one 'lead'... and one lead became four invoices. The Family calls this... efficiency.

lines.action: opening door to four sweating plumbers
lines.vo: Oh my — is this a plumbah convention, deah? There's so many of yous.
lines.cc: Oh my — is this a plumber convention, dear? There's so many of you.

lines.vo: I paid fawty bucks ta lose a footrace!
lines.cc: I paid forty bucks to lose a footrace!

lines.vo: Technic'ly ya paid ta entah da footrace, boss.
lines.cc: Technically you paid to enter the footrace, boss.

lines.vo: Vinnie, it should be noted, was da only honest man in da buildin'. Da Family considahed dis a flaw.
lines.cc: Vinnie, it should be noted, was the only honest man in the building. The Family considered this a flaw.

scenes.title: SCENE 3 — THE SQUEEZE
scenes.action: Don Angelo throws an arm around Sal. Dollar signs float ominously.

lines.vo: Sal. Sal. You lose da job, you buy more leads. You win da job... you buy more leads. Eidah way... capisce?
lines.cc: Sal. Sal. You lose the job, you buy more leads. You win the job... you buy more leads. Either way... capisce?

lines.vo: Dat's not a business. Dat's a treadmill wit' a fedora.
lines.cc: That's not a business. That's a treadmill with a fedora.

lines.vo: Our hero had found da catch. Now he needed... a way out. Cue da dramatic lightin' we couldn't afford.
lines.cc: Our hero had found the catch. Now he needed... a way out. Cue the dramatic lighting we couldn't afford.

scenes.title: SCENE 4 — THE WAY OUT
scenes.action: Sal pushes the green door. Sunlight. Birds. Suspiciously pleasant.

lines.vo: Behind da green door — no Family. No footrace. Just da homeownahs who came ta Sal's own website... an' decided ta say hello.
lines.cc: Behind the green door — no Family. No footrace. Just the homeowners who came to Sal's own website... and decided to say hello.

lines.vo: 'When a homeownah says yes on ya site, you get dere email. A real name. What dey need. Yours alone — fa seven bucks.'
lines.cc: 'When a homeowner says yes on your site, you get their email. A real name. What they need. Yours alone — for seven bucks.'

lines.vo: No fawh guys?
lines.cc: No four guys?

lines.vo: No fawh guys, Vinnie. Dey come back an' call me.
lines.cc: No four guys, Vinnie. They come back and call me.

lines.vo: It was consent-foist. It was excloosive. An' it cost less den da Don's footrace fee. Mrs. Petunia, fa one, was thrilled ta call a single plumbah.
lines.cc: It was consent-first. It was exclusive. And it cost less than the Don's footrace fee. Mrs. Petunia, for one, was thrilled to call a single plumber.

lines.vo: Sal? It's about the faucet, deah. You're the only one I called.
lines.cc: Sal? It's about the faucet, dear. You're the only one I called.

lines.vo: Da only one...
lines.cc: The only one...

scenes.title: TAG / MOCK CLIFFHANGER
scenes.action: Don Angelo shakes a fist at the green door.

lines.vo: Dis isn't ovah, Wrench! Nobody leaves da Family!
lines.cc: This isn't over, Wrench! Nobody leaves the Family!

lines.vo: But somebody just did. Will da Don adapt? Will Vinnie evah stop tellin' da troot? Will Mrs. Petunia's faucet evah get fixed? Eyy — tune in next time.
lines.cc: But somebody just did. Will the Don adapt? Will Vinnie ever stop telling the truth? Will Mrs. Petunia's faucet ever get fixed? Tune in next time.

lines.vo: Next time: 'A Fistful a' Invoices'... or — 'Da Don Who Knew Too Little.' Fuhgeddaboudit!
lines.cc: Next time: 'A Fistful of Invoices'... or — 'The Don Who Knew Too Little.'
